# **This list only shrinks.** `scripts/ci/check-dead-code.ps1` compares it with the
# merge base and fails on an added row. A row leaves in the commit that wires its
# item, deletes it, dates it, or marks it permanent; a row whose site is gone, or
# whose site's reason changed, fails the gate until the row goes. A row is its
# crate, item, form and reason; `file` is where the site lives today, so a site
# that moves keeps its row with the file column changed (a move, not an addition).
# **A site that is not on this list is dated or permanent.** Dated: its reason
# reads `<TICKET-ID> until YYYY-MM-DD: <why>` (`U-41 until 2026-10-15: the card
# calls it`), and on the day after that date the gate fails it — wire it, delete
# it, or re-ticket it. Permanent: its reason reads `permanent: <why>`, the why
# naming the mechanism the code is kept for (held for its Drop, a serde shape,
# read on one platform, an FFI layout). A door that is built is wired in the same
# ticket, or dated (`docs/CONVENTIONS.md` §八). Prefer `expect` to `allow`: the
# attribute then fails the build on the day the code is used.
